claims.statement: Ephesians describes salvation as God’s gracious gift received through faith and says believers are created in Christ for good works.
James rejects a claim to faith that produces no works, while Hebrews calls believers to confidence, endurance, and continued faithfulness.
Taken together, these passages support the lesson’s big idea: Salvation is God's gift that creates obedient life and calls believers to enduring faithfulness.
